note: Adapted from Maiti & Saha's (2000) original description (in English), the species being new in that paper; the soldier and pseudoworker have prose descriptions and measurement tables, and the original gives the alate as Imago Unknown. The soldier holotype is in the Zoological Survey of India (ZSI Reg. No. 3188/H11); type locality Dibrugarh, Assam, India, with Sibsagar (Maranhat) also known.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head chestnut-brown, darker in front; mandibles black, paler towards the condyles; antennae and labrum pale brown; pronotum, legs and abdomen relatively hairy. Body length about 12.00—13.15 mm. Head capsule rectangular, the head width slightly more than half the head length, the sides almost parallel, the frons distinctly sloping forwards. Compound eyes whitish and elongate, their length slightly greater than the distance from the antennal fossa to the compound eye. Y suture indistinct; ocelli absent. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 slightly more strongly sclerotized and slightly longer than segment 2 and far longer than segment 4. Anteclypeus band-like; postclypeus far wider than long. Labrum almost dome-shaped, far wider than long, with a few erect hairs at the tip. Mandibles stout, the tip bluntly incurved, about half the head length; left mandible with 5 marginal teeth: the first blunt and directed upwards, the second blunt and far shorter than the first, the third smaller and situated farther below the second, the margin between them broadly concave, the fourth indistinct with a deep incision between it and the third, the fifth prominent and strongly raised; right mandible with 2 large marginal teeth, the first directed outwards with a weakly incurved posterior margin, the second slightly directed downwards with a long incurved posterior margin. Postmentum long and clavate, the broader front part with a weak lateral notch; the anterior lobe narrower than the posterior lobe and almost square, twice and a half its least width; anterior margin straight, posterior margin concave. Pronotum slightly rectangular and slightly wider than the head; anterior margin deeply concave without a median notch; sides distinctly convex; posterior margin nearly straight or weakly incurved in the middle; scattered hairs all round the margin, the surface less hairy. Legs slender and hairy, apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Cerci short, 2-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head, pronotum and abdomen yellow-white; labrum, clypeus and antennae slightly darker. Body length 9.46—10.20 mm. Head length about equal to the width, almost circular, sparsely hairy. Labrum wider than long. Anteclypeus trapezoidal and whitish. Labrum almost square, wider than long, with a few hairs at the tip. Mandibles of the typical Neotermes type. Compound eyes visible only in strong light. Ocelli absent. Pronotum almost rectangular, slightly wider than the head.
